morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在 w 前呈 me-，w 保留。输入将 mewarisi 整词误标为词根；此处校正为 waris。DBP 将 mewarisi 列为 waris 的派生词。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=28648&keyword=mewariskan)

word_family.gloss: 把遗产或传统传给别人

senses.zh_definition: 继承他人身后留下的财产。
senses.en_definition: To receive property left by someone who has died.
senses.ms_definition: Menerima harta pusaka daripada seseorang; mempusakai.
senses.nuances: 主语是接受遗产的人，宾语是所继承的财产。注意方向：mewarisi 是继承，mewariskan 是传给别人。

senses.zh_definition: 承袭父母或前人的容貌、性格、才能等特征。
senses.en_definition: To inherit or take after the appearance, character, or abilities of a parent or predecessor.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai atau membawa rupa, perangai, sifat atau kebolehan orang tua atau pendahulu.
senses.nuances: 可描述先天特征，也可描述长期熏陶形成的相似之处；单凭此词不能断定某项特征由遗传决定。

senses.zh_definition: 接续前人留下的事业、传统或文化遗产。
senses.en_definition: To receive and carry on a predecessor's work, traditions, or cultural legacy.
senses.ms_definition: Mengikut jejak atau meneruskan pekerjaan, tradisi atau peninggalan orang yang terdahulu.
senses.nuances: 不一定涉及血缘关系或财产转移，常用于文化、技艺和事业的代际传承。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Generasi muda berperanan penting dalam mewarisi dan meneruskan tradisi seni tempatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 年轻一代在承袭和延续本地艺术传统方面发挥着重要作用。
dual_scenarios.en: The younger generation plays an important role in inheriting and carrying on local artistic traditions.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Anak kau memang mewarisi bakat mak dia lah, pandai melukis!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Anak awak memang mewarisi bakat ibunya; dia pandai melukis.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你孩子真是继承了妈妈的天赋，画画很厉害！
dual_scenarios.en: Your child definitely gets that talent from his mum—he's great at drawing!
spoken_features: kau 是熟人之间使用的非正式第二人称代词。
mak dia 对应标准表达 ibunya。
句末 lah 加强肯定语气；此例描写的是男孩。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah tengok lukisan anak kau. Dia memang mewarisi bakat mak dia lah!
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah melihat lukisan anak awak. Dia memang mewarisi bakat ibunya.
messages.zh: 我看过你孩子的画了。他真是继承了妈妈的天赋啊！
messages.en: I've seen your son's drawings. He definitely gets his talent from his mum!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, dia suka melukis je kat rumah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia suka melukis sahaja di rumah.
messages.en: Yeah, drawing is pretty much all he wants to do at home.

etymology.historical_story: The base waris is an Arabic loan associated with heirs and inheritance. Malay builds mewarisi from this base using its own verbal morphology. The resulting verb reaches beyond inherited property: a child can inherit a parent's appearance, while a community can inherit artistic traditions. These meanings connect material inheritance with continuity between generations. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=28648&keyword=mewariskan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 waris「继承人」：继承人接过东西就是 mewarisi；把东西传出去则是 mewariskan。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词语本身中性，正式和日常场合均可使用；向长辈谈论其财产时，避免使用仿佛已经期待继承的语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 赞美孩子承袭长辈的才华通常自然；评论负面性格的家族传承可能冒犯整家人，应谨慎措辞。
